outcome: maternal reasons for poor childbirth experience
cohort: 836 women with poor childbirth experience (VAS < 5) out of 19,442 deliveries at Helsinki University Hospital over a 2-year period
finding: The main reasons for poor childbirth experience were pain, long labor, unplanned cesarean section, and lack of support by caregivers, with differences observed between women who underwent induction of labor (IOL) and those with spontaneous onset of labor (SOL).
mod_finding: Women who underwent IOL more often reported unplanned cesarean section (17.2% vs. 8.3%) and lack of support by caregivers (15.4% vs. 10.7%) as reasons for poor childbirth experience compared to those with SOL.
